stills.title: Four kinds of district
stills.description: Under the default, each district is given a type of its own, and its buildings are that type's kinds, one storey for each fifth of your sessions they have outgrown.

stills.title: The clinic
stills.description: The clinic lists who needs you, then who is in trouble; 1 to 9 jumps to a row.

stills.title: City Hall's groups board
stills.description: City Hall's board lists every group; F2 renames the chosen group, Delete Delete closes it, and t walks a tidy-up.

stills.title: A group's line, between its districts
stills.description: The default form of group_line_form draws a group's line between its districts.

stills.title: A group's line, round its neighbourhoods
stills.description: group_line_form's neighbourhoods form draws outlines round a group's buildings in each district, with links between them.

stills.title: A group's line, building to building
stills.description: group_line_form's sessions form draws a group's line from building to building.

stills.title: A quiet hamlet
stills.description: Two projects late at night, one session working and one waiting on an answer.

stills.title: The hamlet, without the chrome
stills.description: The same night with the interface hidden.

stills.title: Attention
stills.description: Which sessions are waiting for you, and which are working.

stills.title: Spend
stills.description: Where the money went.

stills.title: Pressure
stills.description: Who is about to compact.

stills.title: Staleness
stills.description: What has gone quiet.

stills.title: Servers
stills.description: What breaks if a server goes down.

stills.title: Traffic
stills.description: Which repos talk to each other.

stills.title: Models
stills.description: Where the models are.

stills.title: Fan-out
stills.description: Which sessions spawn armies.

stills.title: Health
stills.description: What is broken, and what shipped.

stills.title: Groups
stills.description: Whose move each piece of work is.

stills.title: The same city by day
stills.description: No view, nothing selected, interface hidden.

stills.title: The same city at night
stills.description: Lit windows mark the sessions that are awake.

stills.title: A busy metropolis
stills.description: Twelve districts in the early evening, a team camp, trains for every model, and the day's finished sessions resting on their lots.

stills.title: The metropolis, without the chrome
stills.description: A dozen districts, interface hidden.

stills.title: Botropolis
stills.description: The metropolis framed for a link preview, interface hidden.

stills.title: The metropolis, plain
stills.description: The same city with the scenery dropped, for reading at a glance.

stills.title: Every session in a list
stills.description: The sidebar lists every session by district and state.

stills.title: Stalls in a residential district
stills.description: Every district here is residential, and each scripted run stands beside the houses as a hot-dog cart.

stills.title: Stalls in a shopping district
stills.description: Every district here is for shopping, and each scripted run is a market stall under a striped awning.

stills.title: Stalls in an office district
stills.description: Every district here is offices, and each scripted run is a coffee kiosk.

stills.title: Stalls in an industrial district
stills.description: Every district here is industrial, and each scripted run is a food trailer.

stills.title: Stalls at night
stills.description: The same streets late in the evening, each stall in its district's own kind.

stills.title: Scripted runs hidden
stills.description: The default, with scripted runs off the map; their tokens and spend still count in the power plant.

stills.title: Tidy up, the first card
stills.description: Start clean, Walk through it, or Later.

stills.title: Tidy up, a group's card
stills.description: The strongest group, its members listed, the camera on its line.

stills.title: Tidy up, the quiet card
stills.description: The sessions in no group quiet for a week, answered pack them up.

stills.title: Before the day begins
stills.description: Two projects with yesterday's sessions resting on their own lots.

stills.title: The start of the morning
stills.description: Three sessions at work before the others arrive.

stills.title: A working afternoon
stills.description: Four projects; sessions working, waiting, running unattended and resting, with the plan's usage on the river.

stills.title: The session that needs you
stills.description: Tab jumps to the next session waiting on an answer and opens its card.

stills.title: Where the tokens go
stills.description: The power plant's breakdown of the last day's tokens and spend.

stills.title: The workshop as a plan
stills.description: One notch out past Skyline, the City Plan shows every district as a badge.

clips.title: A residential district grows
clips.description: Every district here is residential. Sessions arrive and their buildings climb from cottages toward apartment blocks as they work.

clips.title: A shopping district grows
clips.description: Every district here is for shopping. Corner shops become department stores and a shopping centre as their sessions work.

clips.title: An office district grows
clips.description: Every district here is offices. Glass office houses rise into towers as their sessions work.

clips.title: An industrial district grows
clips.description: Every district here is industrial. Workshops become warehouses, distribution centres and a works yard as their sessions work.

clips.title: City Hall and its card
clips.description: City Hall stands on the plaza once Claude Code has computed your statistics; pointing at it shows a card that says how many sessions and messages, your busiest hour and each model's share.

clips.title: Renaming a group on City Hall's board
clips.description: F2 on City Hall's board renames the chosen group, and the line takes the new name at once.

clips.title: The action menu, from its button
clips.description: The action menu hangs just under the button it opened from, with a notch pointing at it; the button stays pressed with its chevron turned up, and the column it opened lights.

clips.title: The action menu, from space
clips.description: Space opens the action menu under the Session button.

clips.title: The action menu, by right-click
clips.description: A right-click still opens the action menu at the pointer.

clips.title: Hold e to see every key
clips.description: While e is held, every control on screen that a key also does wears that key, drawn as a key cap.

clips.title: A group, inside its kerb
clips.description: A group's sessions sit together on neighbouring lots, and a low light kerb runs round the neighbourhood, so a group is found without reading a badge.

clips.title: Pointing at a session lights its group
clips.description: Pointing at a session in a group lights the whole group, and the rest of the city goes dark grey.

clips.title: Closing a group from City Hall's board
clips.description: Close group on City Hall's board asks in a dialog, then packs the group's sessions into the depot as a convoy.

clips.title: Looking in on the hamlet
clips.description: Zoom in on the session that is working, turn the camera, then find the one waiting on an answer.

clips.title: Six ways to read the city
clips.description: The lens key, then each lens in turn -- attention, work, cost, capacity, health and connections -- then night and day.

clips.title: The metropolis, drifting
clips.description: A slow drift over the districts and back, interface hidden, that plays on without a seam.

clips.title: Flying over the metropolis
clips.description: Zoom into the team camp and open a card, glide across the districts, turn, and pull back out.

clips.title: A queue at a stall
clips.description: A scripted run arrives as a stall, and a customer joins its queue for each subagent it sets to work.

clips.title: A team's messages as vans
clips.description: A lead and its teammate in two districts. Each message between them drives along the road as a van.

clips.title: A team's messages with its line drawn
clips.description: The same team with its group's line drawn. Each message between them still drives the road as a van, and the line carries nothing.

clips.title: Closing a group
clips.description: Close group on City Hall's board packs the group's sessions into the depot as a convoy.

clips.title: Tidy up, end to end
clips.description: Walk through it, keep the group, pack up the quiet sessions, and the journal.

clips.title: A day on two projects
clips.description: Sessions arrive by boat, their buildings rise as they work, pull requests merge, and finished sessions rest on their own lots.

clips.title: A morning in forty seconds
clips.description: Sessions arrive by boat, wait on answers, merge pull requests and rest on their own lots when they finish.

clips.title: A tour of the workshop
clips.description: Point at the busiest building and open its card, read its summary, open the power plant, then the sidebar.
